synthetic_signed_url_integrity.scenario: synthetic HMAC includes utm_source among signed query parameters

additional_questions: Which real-site endpoint-specific rules can remove tracking params without modifying signed/authenticated URLs?
Are specific endpoint/path-scoped rules needed and sufficient?
Would the user already have the same behavior from an enabled default or optional uBO/AdGuard list?
Does full uBlock Origin on Firefox behave equivalently?
Do login/checkout/redirect links survive controlled on/off live-site tests?
conclusion: Global removeparam=utm_source changes HTTP requests and breaks a synthetic HMAC-signed URL. A narrowly scoped alternative requires real site safety evidence; zero active additions, NO_GO.
